fidelity: F2a — Lumped Reaction-Network Kinetics + Reactor Energy-Balance ODE
source: Toor et al. (2011) Energy 36:2328 (HTL review); Valdez & Savage (2013) Algal Research 2:416 (lumped kinetic network); Valdez et al. (2014) ACS Sustain. Chem. Eng. 2:1841; Sheehan & Savage (2017) Bioresour. Technol. 239:144 (temperature-dependent rate constants)
description: Physics-lumped HTL model. Wet biomass is liquefied in hot compressed (subcritical) water (~300-350 C, 15-20 MPa). A 4-lump reaction network (biomass -> biocrude / aqueous / gas / solid) with first-order Arrhenius rates, including secondary biocrude decomposition, is integrated together with a stirred-reactor energy-balance ODE via scipy.solve_ivp. Biocrude yield peaks at intermediate severity (time x temperature).

unit.name: Generic batch HTL reactor (microalgae/lignocellulose surrogate), subcritical water

A_BC.note: Pre-exponential: biomass -> biocrude (primary liquefaction). Calibrated so k=0.18 1/min at 350C, matching Valdez & Savage 2013 lumped-network primary-liquefaction rates

Ea_BC.note: Activation energy biomass->biocrude (Valdez & Savage 2013: 30-100 kJ/mol range for primary liquefaction lumps)

A_BG.note: Pre-exponential: biomass -> gas (decarboxylation). k=0.03 1/min at 350C; higher Ea so gas favoured at high severity

Ea_BG.note: Activation energy biomass->gas (gasification competes at high T)

A_BS.note: Pre-exponential: biomass -> solid residue (char/unconverted). k=0.05 1/min at 350C; low Ea -> weakly T-dependent

A_CG.note: Pre-exponential: biocrude -> gas (secondary cracking). k=0.004 1/min at 350C; drives the intermediate-severity biocrude yield peak

Ea_CG.note: Activation energy biocrude->gas secondary decomposition (high Ea: only at high severity)

A_CA.note: Pre-exponential: biocrude -> aqueous (secondary repolymerisation/dissolution). k=0.003 1/min at 350C

T_ref.note: Reference temperature 350 C for rate normalisation

dH_rxn.note: Net reaction enthalpy of liquefaction; mildly exothermic per Toor 2011 / Peterson 2008 energetics

m_slurry.note: Total slurry mass in reactor (water + biomass) basis

cp_slurry.note: Effective slurry heat capacity; near subcritical water cp (water cp rises to ~5-8 kJ/kg.K near critical point, IAPWS-IF97)

UA_heater.note: Overall heater conductance (electric jacket) driving reactor to setpoint

rho_water.note: Liquid water density at 320 C, 16 MPa subcritical (IAPWS-IF97), confirms compressed-liquid (not vapour) regime

Psat_350C_MPa.note: Saturation pressure of water at 350 C; operating P must exceed this to keep water subcritical liquid

Tc_water_C.note: Critical temperature of water; HTL is subcritical (T < 374 C)

LHV_biocrude.note: Lower heating value of HTL biocrude (Toor 2011: 30-36 MJ/kg)

T_setpoint_C.note: Subcritical HTL window; capped below water Tc
